actions.reason: K8_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity: a coherent down-regulated oxidative-phosphorylation/metabolic RNA phenotype (OXPHOS NES -1.969, FDR q 0.001) and a concordant WXS driver profile of near-universal PBRM1 (13/13, q_global 0.0027) and VHL enrichment (q_driver 0.0014). Membership representation is mixed (WXS strongly separates, CT/RNA/WSI do not), but the relevant boundary to the nearest neighbor (merged set) is positively supported in candidate-consensus geometry: independent two-way spectral ARI 1.0 with within-side affinity 0.321 exceeding cross-boundary 0.116, providing affirmative evidence of independent representation. The union eigengap candidate_k=1 is merge-compatible and not treated as positive evidence, and no supported split or merge rescue is available. The candidate remains a defensible independent discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0002 has a strong, internally consistent biological identity: immune-suppressed RNA phenotype (allograft rejection NES -2.722, IFN-gamma -2.632) with elevated OXPHOS, and a coherent WXS VHL-wild-type profile (0/15 mutated, q_global 0.0066) that is the inverse of K8_C0001. Although set-scope membership representation is weak (all four native geometries non-positive), the relevant boundaries are positively supported: K8_C0002–K8_C0005 shows coherent cross-modal separation (all four modalities positive) with ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.384 vs cross-boundary 0.107, and moderate normalized-cut 0.462; K8_C0002–K8_C0003 shows coherent (if weak) cross-modal separation with ARI 0.871. These affirmative boundary results establish independent representation despite the weak set-scope alignment, and no supported split or merge rescue is available.

K8_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: an up-regulated inflammatory/immune-activation RNA phenotype (TNFa/NFKB NES 2.759, FDR q 0.001) that is directionally opposite to the immune-suppressed K8_C0002. Membership representation is mixed (CT/WSI positive, RNA/WXS negative), but the relevant boundary to K8_C0002 is positively supported: all four native geometries show weakly positive separation in the same direction, and candidate-consensus geometry shows a largely represented boundary (ARI 0.871, within-side affinity 0.399 vs cross-boundary 0.173). The high normalized-cut cost (0.634) and single-cluster-dominated union are noted but do not override the affirmative boundary representation, and no supported split or merge rescue is available.

The merged set K8_C0004_M_K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 has an interpretable composite biological identity (immune-suppressed RNA phenotype: allograft rejection NES -2.361, IFN-gamma -2.248, with Wnt/TGF-beta up-regulation), though its WXS driver profile is not multiplicity-robust and its set-scope membership representation is weak (CT/WSI/WXS non-positive, RNA weakly positive). Its relevant boundary to the nearest neighbor K8_C0001 is positively supported in candidate-consensus geometry (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.321 vs cross-boundary 0.116), providing affirmative evidence of independent representation. The union eigengap candidate_k=1 is merge-compatible and not treated as positive evidence, and no supported split or merge rescue is available. The composite label is retained as a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K8_C0005 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: a strongly up-regulated interferon/inflammatory RNA phenotype (IFN-gamma NES 2.874, allograft rejection 2.838, IFN-alpha 2.832, FDR q 0.001). Membership representation is conflicting (CT/RNA weakly positive, WSI/WXS negative), but the relevant boundary to K8_C0002 is positively supported: all four native geometries show positive separation in the same direction, and candidate-consensus geometry shows a strongly represented boundary (ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.384 vs cross-boundary 0.107, moderate normalized-cut 0.462). The flatter union gap profile is merge-compatible and not treated as positive evidence, and no supported split or merge rescue is available.

K8_C0007 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: a mesenchymal/stromal RNA phenotype (EMT NES 2.531, FDR q 0.001) with a concordant WXS profile of VHL enrichment (13/13, q_driver 0.0028) and PBRM1 depletion (0/13, q_driver 0.0118), distinct from the PBRM1-enriched K8_C0001. Membership representation is conflicting (WXS strongly separates, CT/RNA/WSI do not), but the candidate is not the nearest neighbor of any strongly competing boundary (its closest structural pair, K8_C0005, has mean between-affinity 0.066, well below the top competing boundaries), and no supported split or merge rescue is available. The interpretable, mutation-anchored identity supports retention as a defensible discovery-stage unit.
